name: @plusguard/marquee
description: Scrolling strips that loop without a seam: announcement bars, logo rows, testimonial columns. Flows at a set speed in px/s, or steps one item at a time; moves only when it does not fit, if you like; speeds up and turns with the page's scroll. Pauses on hover and focus, stops for reduced motion. No dependencies.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,dom.iterable,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
